name: Detect and triage risky OAuth apps with Anthropic Claude and Slack

parameters.content:
## Suspicious OAuth Application Detector

Watches newly authorized third-party apps and OAuth grants across your identity provider, flags the ones requesting unusual or excessive scopes, and automatically routes each finding to the right response - revoke, review, or silently approve.

Unlike a single-pass approve/reject pipeline, this workflow diffs against a known-good baseline first (so Claude only spends effort on apps that are actually new or changed), then fans out into three different automated response paths based on Claude's risk tier.

### How it works
1. A cron job polls the identity provider's OAuth grants on a schedule.
2. In parallel, it pulls the current known-app baseline/whitelist.
3. A Code node diffs the two: new apps, and existing apps whose scopes changed, are flagged for review; everything else is ignored.
4. If nothing new or changed is found, the cycle ends immediately - no AI call, no noise.
5. Flagged apps are enriched with a publisher/domain reputation lookup.
6. Claude scores every flagged app's risk (Low / Medium / High) with reasoning, based on scopes requested, publisher reputation, and user count.
7. A Switch node routes each app by risk tier: High triggers an automatic revoke + critical Slack alert, Medium goes to a human-review Slack alert, Low is logged and silently approved.
8. All three branches merge back and update the baseline store so the next cycle only looks at what's truly new.

### Setup
1. Import this workflow into n8n and activate it.
2. Add your identity provider (Okta/Azure AD/Google Workspace) API credentials to Fetch Authorized OAuth Apps.
3. Add your baseline store API credentials to Fetch Baseline Whitelist and Update Baseline Store.
4. Add a reputation/threat-intel API credential to Enrich App Reputation.
5. Add your Anthropic Claude credentials to the Anthropic model node.
6. Add Slack and admin-API credentials for the response branches.

### Customization
- Adjust what counts as a 'changed' grant (scope diff sensitivity) in JS - Diff Against Baseline.
- Tighten or loosen the risk-tier thresholds Claude uses to classify High vs Medium vs Low.
- Require human approval before any auto-revoke by removing the direct HTTP revoke call and routing High risk to an approval Slack message instead.
- Add a weekly digest of all Low-risk auto-approved apps for periodic human audit.

## Stage 1: Discovery & Baseline Diff

- **Cron - OAuth Scan Trigger** — polls on a schedule (every 30 minutes) to start each scan cycle.
- **HTTP - Fetch Authorized OAuth Apps** — pulls all currently authorized OAuth apps from the identity provider. 🔑
- **HTTP - Fetch Baseline Whitelist** — pulls the known-app baseline/whitelist in parallel. 🔑
- **Merge - Combine Apps & Baseline** — combines the current apps and baseline into one item.
- **JS - Diff Against Baseline** — flags apps that are new or have changed scopes vs the baseline.
- **IF - New or Changed Grants Found?** — branches to enrichment if anything was flagged, else ends the cycle.
- **No Action - End Cycle** — ends the run with no AI call when nothing new or changed was found.

## Stage 2: Enrichment & Risk Scoring

- **HTTP - Enrich App Reputation** — looks up publisher/domain reputation for each flagged app. 🔑
- **JS - Attach Reputation to Flagged Apps** — merges the reputation lookup results back onto each flagged app.
- **Wait For Model Buffer** — brief pause before calling the model.
- **Claude - OAuth Risk Scoring** — asks Claude to assign each flagged app a risk tier with reasoning.
- **Anthropic - Risk Scoring Model** — the Claude model used by the risk-scoring node. 🔑
- **JS - Parse Risk Scores** — parses Claude's assessments, defaulting to Medium risk if parsing fails.

## Stage 3: Tiered Automated Response

- **Switch - Route by Risk Tier** — routes each app to auto-revoke, manual review, or silent approval by risk tier.
- **HTTP - Auto-Revoke OAuth Grant** — immediately revokes the OAuth grant for High-risk apps. 🔑
- **Slack - Critical Alert (App Revoked)** — posts a critical alert when a high-risk app is auto-revoked. 🔑
- **Slack - Alert (Manual Review Required)** — posts a review alert for Medium-risk apps. 🔑
- **JS - Log & Approve Silently** — logs and silently approves Low-risk apps.
- **Merge - All Branches** — merges all three response branches back into one flow.
- **HTTP - Update Baseline Store** — updates the baseline so next cycle only looks at what's truly new. 🔑
